# Field layout contract — captured, not implemented in this pass

This build deliberately does not spend runtime work on future visualization.

The field contract to preserve is:

- center: **Space / the user / the user's current place**;
- outer field: **Movement, Evolution, Being, Design**;
- each outer dimension has **micro and macro** availability;
- the ordinary user can occupy/access one place at a time and will usually be in **Home**;
- alternate dimensional views, color/filter overlays, wider YOU-N-I-VERSE spaces, and their final visual grammar are deferred;
- Synthia's autonomous runtime should eventually be able to generate or evolve those surfaces instead of requiring them to be manually designed before the organism works.

No UI implementation is implied by this note. It exists so future generated surfaces do not erase the intended geometry while the headless organism is being completed.
